Problems require reading bar graph values, basic arithmetic operations including addition, subtraction, and multiplication with various unit costs ranging from 2 to 10 pesos. Addition word problems involving combining existing values with new items are well-suited to Grade 3 developmental level without overwhelming complexity.

The stems explicitly ask for problem-solving outcomes based on reading and interpreting data, with no extraneous content that diverts from the core competency of data interpretation and problem-solving.
